parsed.note_claim: On 2 January 2024, JAL Flight 516 collided with a Japan Coast Guard DHC-8 at Haneda Airport; all JAL passengers survived, while the DHC-8 had five fatalities and one survivor.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Five of the six crew on board the Dash 8 died in the collision, leaving only the captain alive. Everyone on board the A350 survived.
parsed.reason: The page directly confirms the date, location, aircraft involved, zero fatalities on JAL 516, and five fatalities with one survivor on the Coast Guard DHC-8.
